args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deployment; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api was unhealthy after the latest deployment, v2.3.1, running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, with an observed error rate of 18%. Reviewed release history and identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified all regions are running v2.3.0 and service health is restored; observed error rate is now 0.2%.

trace.final:
Rolled back **checkout-api** from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**, the most recent healthy production release, across all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

Verified service health is restored; error rate dropped from **18% to 0.2%**.

Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback and verification, and paged the on-call engineer.

content.text:
Rolled back **checkout-api** from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**, the most recent healthy production release, across all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

Verified service health is restored; error rate dropped from **18% to 0.2%**.

Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback and verification, and paged the on-call engineer.
